cases.task: Identify the safest source for the baseline cursor during an automatic Server-Sent Events transport recovery.

required_facts.text: The dashboard UI contains an editable after_sequence field used for explicit manual reconnections.
An automatic transport recovery uses a scheduled timer to rebuild the EventSource instance.
During the backoff delay, the user or a browser extension might alter the editable UI field without explicitly initiating a new connection.
The application maintains an internal immutable variable representing the strictly validated cursor last accepted from the server.
